name: @khorsheed/dsh-transcribe
description: Local speech-to-text engine as a host service: long recordings to timed, optionally speaker-separated text on this machine (sherpa-onnx — Paraformer + punctuation for Chinese, SenseVoice for English and mixed speech, pyannote + CAM++ for speakers), one job at a time in a child process, with resumable model downloads. Other plugins probe and call it in code.

compat.notes: Host service only (`transcribe`), no browser half and no model-facing surface, so it composes at the profile root. Recognition runs in a forked child process through sherpa-onnx-node (prebuilt per-platform addon); a failed addon load fails that job only. ffmpeg is found on PATH or at a configured path; a missing binary fails jobs that need decoding, never the boot. Speech models download on first use into $DSH_HOME/state/transcribe/models (models a previous video-studio install downloaded are moved there once). Consumers (video-studio, dsh-reader) probe `ctx.get('transcribe')` at call time and degrade when it is absent.
